lines.zh: 胸口的南瓜灯一晃一晃
lines.en: The jack-o-lantern on my chest sways.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，光在墙上动
lines.en: Where I pass, light moves on the wall.
Old cotton packs my suit.
My ears sit crooked and swing as I walk.
I'm not chasing; only walking.

lines.zh: 地面上的影子拖着一条长耳朵
lines.en: My shadow drags a long ear behind it.

lines.zh: 脚底的接缝裂了，走起来漏棉
lines.en: A seam split at my foot and cotton leaks.

lines.zh: 这一间屋子，我绕了几圈
lines.en: I've circled this room several times.

lines.zh: 每一步都踏在原来的位置上
lines.en: Each step lands where the last one did.
I'm slow, but I never stop.

lines.zh: 走廊的灯照着我，南瓜灯更亮
lines.en: The hall light hits me and my pumpkin glows brighter.
I raise a hand; three joints pop.
I hold this pose.
The flame inside my pumpkin dances.

lines.zh: 我歪着头，看墙上的海报
lines.en: I tilt my head at the poster on the wall.

lines.zh: 身上的布很旧，一碰就掉毛
lines.en: The cloth is old; touching it sheds.
I'm not waiting for anyone.
When the lights go out, I'm still lit.

lines.zh: 这间屋子里只有我一个人
lines.en: I'm the only one in this room.

lines.zh: 里面的骨架卡住了一下
lines.en: The frame inside caught for a moment.
The pumpkin smells faintly sweet.
I don't move, and the flame keeps burning.
You've seen the light in my chest.
Don't touch the pumpkin; there's fire in it.

lines.zh: 这张脸是缝的，南瓜是挖的
lines.en: This face is stitched, the pumpkin carved.
You're far enough; go farther.
I don't like being stared at.
You look at me like a joke.
It isn't Halloween tonight.

lines.zh: 你手里那盏灯，没我的亮
lines.en: That lantern of yours isn't as bright as mine.

lines.zh: 我这张脸，只在秋天挂着
lines.en: This face only hangs in autumn.
One step closer and I'll turn my head.
Cotton spills from a seam.
The pumpkin tilted; the flame held.
Half an ear came off.
I don't cry out; I have no voice.
That split the suit.
I back off, and the flame keeps burning.
The light dimmed, then came back.
Hit again and I'll walk forward.

lines.zh: 南瓜，我只对南瓜有兴趣
lines.en: Pumpkins, I'm only interested in pumpkins.

lines.zh: 你抱着那个，是想给我吗
lines.en: You're holding that; is it for me?
I don't eat, but I like pumpkins.

lines.zh: 那个挖空的，正好换我胸口这个
lines.en: That hollowed one would do for my chest.
Put the pumpkin down and let me look.
Skip the candy.

lines.zh: 这个太小，火撑不了多久
lines.en: This one's too small to hold a flame.

lines.zh: 我不饿，我只是想要个新灯
lines.en: I'm not hungry; I just want a new lantern.
Leave it; I won't touch it.
That won't buy me.
You bumped me and some cotton fell.
The pumpkin rocked, the flame held.
You stepped on my foot seam.
Don't lean on me; the suit is dusty.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，南瓜还在亮
lines.en: I took half a step; the pumpkin still glows.

lines.zh: 这一下把我的耳朵撞歪了
lines.en: That knocked an ear crooked.
Suit against suit, muffled.

lines.zh: 你从我旁边挤过去，火苗晃了
lines.en: You squeezed past and the flame guttered.
I don't push; I stand.
Make room, I'm going through.

lines.zh: 我是玩偶，不是那种东西
lines.en: I'm an animatronic, not that sort of thing.

lines.zh: 仓库里还有别的，落了灰
lines.en: There are others in the storeroom, dusty.
Displayed together, we look like a pair.
That line isn't in the program.

lines.zh: 我胸口这盏火，给不了谁
lines.en: This flame in my chest isn't for giving.

lines.zh: 秋天过了，我就得收起来
lines.en: After autumn I'll be packed away.
Don't ask an animatronic that.

lines.zh: 我们不生，我们只是被做出来
lines.en: We don't beget; we're only made.

lines.zh: 架子那只好久没动过了
lines.en: The one on the shelf hasn't moved in ages.
Go away; I've nothing to say.
My hands can only pinch, not grip.
I nudge fallen things with my foot.

lines.zh: 这个能塞进布套的缝里
lines.en: This fits into a seam of my suit.
Something bright on the ground.
Bending jams my frame.
I picked it up and the cotton got dusty.
This isn't mine; I won't take it.
Leave it for someone else.
I carry it two steps and drop it.
Better the floor is clean.
You hit me.
That made the pumpkin sway.
I don't start it, but I answer.
The flame in my pumpkin suddenly grew.
I turn my head to you.

lines.zh: 现在这间屋子，只剩我们
lines.en: Now only the two of us remain in this room.
You've backed to the wall.
Tonight didn't have to go this way.
You gripped what's in your hand.
I'm not afraid of your hits.
The light here won't go out on you.
I've marked your position.
This time, I move first.

lines.zh: 你退了三步，我进了两步
lines.en: You took three back; I took two forward.
The pumpkin's light finds your face.
I'm not fast, but I keep coming.
You hit the counter.

lines.zh: 我的关节在响，是准备好了
lines.en: My joints are creaking; I'm ready.

lines.zh: 你换了口气，我也听见了
lines.en: You took a breath; I heard it.
This room has one door.
You lift a chair to block.
A chair won't stop me.
Your feet are edging toward the door.
I stand at the door first.
You look back; no one's there.
The flame leans toward you.
I keep this step slow.
Two steps more.
You're holding your breath.
My ear turned your way.
No hurry; the diner won't run.

lines.zh: 最后一个晚上，总是最长的
lines.en: The last night is always the longest.
A flat hand comes down.
The pumpkin strikes and flames scatter.
That wasn't heavy, and you still backed up.
I lift a foot and bring it down.
The iron in my suit hit him.
You blocked once, hands shaking.
I caught his sleeve.

lines.zh: 这一下带着南瓜的焦味
lines.en: That one carried scorched pumpkin smell.
He retreated; I don't chase.
One more to put him down.
My moves are clumsy.
But my weight is enough.

lines.zh: 他撞在柜台上，没有再起来
lines.en: He hit the counter and didn't get up.
I look down at him, the flame burning.

lines.zh: 这一下，不是万圣节的玩笑
lines.en: That wasn't a Halloween joke.
I raise my hand for the second.
He's still breathing, so I'm not done.
The suit split and cotton spilled.
I push him toward the wall.
I stopped.

lines.zh: 柜子里空了，我站在门前
lines.en: The cabinet was empty; I stood at the door.

lines.zh: 南瓜灯亮起来的时候，我才醒
lines.en: I only woke when the pumpkin lit.

lines.zh: 今天是秋天，不是万圣节
lines.en: It's autumn, not Halloween.
I was carried from the storeroom to the corridor.

lines.zh: 身上的灰被拍掉了一半
lines.en: Half the dust was beaten off me.

lines.zh: 刷怪蛋打开，我就出现在这里
lines.en: The spawn egg opened and here I am.
This flame has always been lit.
My ears are still crooked.
Someone reopened the diner.
I raise a hand and a joint pops.
There are footsteps down the hall.
Tonight, there's no costume to wear.

lines.zh: 我身上本来就是火，烧不到我
lines.en: I'm already fire here; it doesn't burn me.
I hit the ground, pumpkin first.
Soaked in river water, the flame goes out.
Half my face was blown away.
The arrow sank into the cotton.

lines.zh: 法术打在南瓜上，火跳起来
lines.en: The spell struck the pumpkin and the flame leapt.
I don't eat; I only burn pumpkin.

lines.zh: 雷落下来，整只玩偶亮了一下
lines.en: Lightning fell and the whole animatronic lit up.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有风，火还亮着
lines.en: No wind in the void, and the flame still burns.
